title: Double Drip 10K Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods + Refill
description: This Double Drip 10K Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack is made for use with the Double Drip 10K Pod Kit, offering a quick and easy way to replenish your kit with no refilling or coil swaps. Each pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml bottle of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 10,000 puffs with smooth, reliable vapour performance. Cherry Ice delivers a juicy Cherry base topped with a crisp, brisk Menthol finish. The rich, ruby fruit note is balanced beautifully by the clean chill of Ice, creating a sharp yet sweet vape that’s ideal for fans of fruity menthol flavours. To switch flavours or replace your used pod, simply insert the new ones and let the auto-refill system keep the vape flowing. A no-fuss option for flavour lovers who value convenience.
